title: Scope the assessment
outcome: Start with the workflow, people, and evidence gaps.

title: Score a threat
outcome: Calculate CTSS from five reasoned inputs.

title: Select controls
outcome: Choose stable mitigation IDs and tests.

title: Test capability
outcome: Record evidence-backed ratings, unknowns, and repairs.

title: Learn from the unit example
outcome: Follow a synthetic case across all six domains.

title: Collect Domain 6 self-report
outcome: Use habits to choose observed checks; do not call self-report demonstrated capability.

title: Record a decision
outcome: Keep criteria, evidence, dissent, scope, and authorization.

title: Explain safeguards
outcome: Give the team a short instruction linked to controls.

title: Investigate a recurring signal
outcome: Define the question, protocol, and trigger.

title: Explain a score
outcome: Show the factors, reasons, evidence, and action.

title: Plan a bounded pilot
outcome: Set benefit, burden, consent, and stop criteria before participant work.
